tagline: Europe's leading residential real estate company
hero_kpi_rationale: Key lever of financial strategy in residential real estate: low LTV enables greater M&A flexibility and resilience to rate changes. Structural valuation driver.

kpis.name: Debt to Total Value Ratio (LTV)
kpis.explanation: Share of debt relative to total value of real estate assets.
kpis.description: LTV is a key solvency indicator in real estate. A declining ratio shows a reduction in leverage effect.

kpis.name: Adjusted Total EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Gross operating result adjusted, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA reflects core operational performance, rising thanks to portfolio management.

kpis.name: Investments (maintenance, modernization, new)
kpis.explanation: Annual expenditures for maintenance, modernization and new residential construction.
kpis.description: Includes maintenance, modernization and new construction. Significant increase in 2025 following previous decline.
kpis.signal: Strong Capex growth: signal of quality and sustainability commitment

kpis.name: Operating Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after routine capital investments.
kpis.description: Remains elevated despite increased investment spending.

kpis.name: Adjusted Rental EBITDA
kpis.explanation: EBITDA generated from core rental operations.
kpis.description: The rental segment remains the pillar of group profitability with sustained organic growth.

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Approximately 12,708 employees in 2025 versus 12,056 in 2024, reflecting operational development.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 1.22 EUR in latest year.

kpis.name: Number of Units Managed
kpis.explanation: Total residential units under management, owned and third-party.
kpis.description: Unit count slightly declining, indicating a selective divestiture strategy.
kpis.signal: Slight portfolio reduction: priority on quality over volume

kpis.name: New Construction (to Hold)
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in construction of new units retained in portfolio.
kpis.description: Investment significantly higher in 2025, following decline in 2024.

kpis.name: Average Monthly Rent
kpis.explanation: Average monthly rent per square meter.
kpis.description: Growth of 4.6% reflecting organic growth of 4.1% and portfolio quality improvements.

kpis.name: CO2 Intensity in Germany
kpis.explanation: CO2 emissions per square meter of space in Germany.
kpis.description: Decline in carbon intensity driven by modernization investments and energy efficiency improvements.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in provided documents. Strategy focuses on traditional real estate management, sustainability and operational efficiency.
evidence: No AI reference in business model
Absence of KPIs related to automation or predictive analytics
Focus on physical maintenance and real estate capex
